# sofascore_scraper.store.ChangeLog
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/changes.py
class ChangeLog:
    def __init__(self, store: 'Store') -> None
    def append(self, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int
    def list(self, *, after_seq: int = 0, event_id: Optional[int] = None, since: Optional[float] = None, limit: int = 1000) -> List[ChangeRow]
    def last_seq(self) -> int
